description: This file contains unit tests for the class MessageCommandAckRequestSetter, which modifies MessageCommand objects by adding or removing acknowledgment request headers related to message acknowledgments in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: MessageCommandAckRequestSetterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for MessageCommandAckRequestSetter, verifying its behavior in various scenarios of modifying message acknowledgment headers.

methods.name: tryToApplyNullCommand
methods.description: Checks that applying a null command throws NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: addLiveResponseAckLabelByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that the default behavior adds a 'LIVE_RESPONSE' acknowledgment label and sets responseRequired to true.

methods.name: removeLiveResponseAckLabelWhenResponseRequiredFalse
methods.description: Ensures that if responseRequired is false, the 'LIVE_RESPONSE' acknowledgment label is removed.

methods.name: removeLiveResponseAckLabelFromOthersWhenResponseRequiredFalse
methods.description: Checks removal of the 'LIVE_RESPONSE' label when response is not required, even from multiple acknowledgment requests.

methods.name: filterOutOtherBuiltInDittoAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Ensures that only the 'LIVE_RESPONSE' acknowledgment label remains when multiple acknowledgments are present.

methods.name: addsLiveResponseAckLabelToAlreadyRequiredAckLabels
methods.description: Verifies that if acknowledgment labels are already marked as required, the 'LIVE_RESPONSE' label is added appropriately.

methods.name: notAddingLiveResponseAckLabelToExplicitlyEmptyRequiredAckLabels
methods.description: Ensures that if acknowledgment requests are explicitly empty, no 'LIVE_RESPONSE' label is added.
